diagnostics.message: The Security Hub baseline is enabled in the organization master account, but its account activation resources have no dependency on aws_organizations_organization.org. Security Hub organization setup depends on AWS Organizations being created/available first; otherwise account enrollment can fail during initial provisioning.

aws_accessanalyzer_analyzer.default is configured with type ORGANIZATION for the master account, but has no dependency on the organization resource. Ensure the organization exists before creating an organization analyzer.

The Config organization aggregator in the master account relies on AWS Organizations being initialized, but aws_config_configuration_aggregator.organization has no dependency on the organization resource. Add an ordering dependency so aggregator creation does not race organization setup.
